name: Samsung Superstar Galaxy
desc:
CHARLI HAS GONE ON TOUR...NOW IT'S YOUR TIME TO SHINE!

Ready to become the Galaxy’s greatest superstar? 💫 In Superstar Galaxy, you can dance along to exciting songs, perform on stage for all your friends, and customize your look and stage props!

⭐️ Earn Star Power to unlock new gear
🚀 Explore the Superstar space station
🏗 Customize your own pop star stage
💖 PERFORM YOUR HEART OUT

WANT MORE SUPERSTAR GALAXY? ⭐️ LET US KNOW WITH YOUR FAVORITES AND UPVOTES!
